---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspections"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
```

```{r data, include = FALSE}
data("rest_inspec")

rest_inspec = 
  rest_inspec |>
  rename(borough = boro) |>
  filter(
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"),
    !borough %in% c("Missing", "0"),
    !is.na(score),
    score >= 0
  ) |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(borough = str_to_title(borough))
```


Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Restaurant locations by most recent 2019 grade

```{r}
rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    inspection_date >= "2019-01-01",
    !str_detect(inspection_type, "Reopening"),
    !is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude),
    latitude != 0, longitude != 0
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(inspection_date)) |>
  distinct(camis, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c(
      str_to_title(dba), "\nBorough: ", borough,
      "\nScore: ", score, "\nGrade: ", grade
    )
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~longitude, y = ~latitude, color = ~grade, text = ~text_label,
    type = "scatter", mode = "markers", alpha = 0.5,
    colors = c("#1a9850", "#fdae61", "#d73027")
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Longitude"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Latitude"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Grade"))
  )
```

Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Inspection scores by borough

```{r}
rest_inspec |>
  mutate(borough = fct_reorder(borough, score)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~borough, y = ~score, color = ~borough, type = "box", colors = "viridis"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Borough"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection score (lower is better)")
  )
```

### Cuisines with the worst average scores

```{r}
rest_inspec |>
  group_by(cuisine_description) |>
  summarize(
    mean_score = mean(score),
    n_inspections = n()
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(n_inspections >= 200) |>
  filter(min_rank(desc(mean_score)) <= 10) |>
  mutate(cuisine_description = case_when(
    str_detect(cuisine_description, "Latin") ~ "Latin",
    TRUE ~ cuisine_description
  )) |>
  mutate(cuisine_description = fct_reorder(cuisine_description, mean_score)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~mean_score, y = ~cuisine_description, color = ~cuisine_description,
    type = "bar", colors = "viridis"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Mean score (higher = worse)"),
    yaxis = list(title = ""),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```
